about: Curated traversal for the shooter map graphs in maps.json: node levels (0 = ground) and typed links. Types: walk, stairs, ladder, door, vent, breakable, drop (one-way down), teleport (one-way). 'retype' changes an existing edge; 'add' adds a link. Facts from the Valorant and Counter-Strike Fandom wikis (CC BY-SA), checked 21 Nov 2026. The graphs are simplified 2D callout networks, not official geometry. 'carve' opens a corridor of the given half-width (map units) through the drawn walls along a link (a layout correction).

valorant:bind.source: https://valorant.fandom.com/wiki/Bind — 'two one-way teleporters. One takes players from A Short to B Short and the other takes players from B Long to A Lobby.'

valorant:lotus.source: https://valorant.fandom.com/wiki/Lotus — rotating doors toggled from either side (10 s rotation); a destructible wall (400 HP) between A Main and A Link; a silenced drop from A Top to A Drop.
valorant:lotus.note: A Drop is a ledge: dropped onto from A Top and dropped off into A Site (both one-way; the 2D raster draws the ledge as a wall, so the link down into the site is a drop, not a walk).

valorant:haven.source: https://valorant.fandom.com/wiki/Haven — three bomb sites (A, B, C).

cs2:nuke.source: https://counterstrike.fandom.com/wiki/Nuke — two levels: Upper A and Lower B joined by Ramp, Secret stairs and the vents between the sites (vent covers can be opened and closed); Heaven above A. Hut and Squeaky open onto A through doors (closed doors block sight; they take a moment to open).
cs2:nuke.calibration: holdScale 0.25: a holding defender's first-shot edge at a quarter of the usual on this map. With the doors alone attackers won 18% of rounds (24 seeded games); 0.4 gave 38%, 0.1 gave 48%; 0.25 aims at the real map's CT lean (attackers a little under half).

valorant:sunset.source: Layout correction (QA, 27 Nov 2026): on Sunset B Main runs from B Lobby into B site. The exported graph had B Main as a dead end reachable only from the site, so every attack on B went through Market from Mid and attackers won 9% of rounds on the map (16 seeded games, MapStatsProbeTest); with the link restored they win 53%. A corridor is carved through the drawn walls along the link. Simplified 2D layout from the map's public lane structure, not measured geometry.

valorant:summit.calibration: holdScale 2.1: attackers won 66% of rounds at 1.0 and 56% at 1.8 (24 seeded games each); 2.1 aims at about 52%.

valorant:corrode.calibration: holdScale 1.4: attackers won 62% of rounds at 1.0 and 41% at 1.8 (24 seeded games each); 1.4 aims at about 52%.
